detail: Stata label: 'Simulated data on udder infection of dairy cows'. The [ME] meintreg interval-censored example (farm/cow nested, lnleft lnright i.multiparous). Explicitly simulated, so excluded although the grouping (farm, cow) is real.

A 100,000-row [ME] mestreg demonstration dataset carrying its data-generating columns: re (the per-group random effect), xb (linear predictor), lambda (Weibull scale), u (uniform draw) and the generated survival time t. Simulated to show random-effect recovery; excluded.

Brain weight of 30 male and 30 female unicorns in the fictional land of Zootopia ('Longitudinal Study of Unicorn Health'), the [ME] menl two-level syntax-illustration dataset. RULE GAP: the manual does not use the word 'simulated', but unicorns are fictional so the data are fabricated; treated as simulated as the [XT] shard treated 'fictitious' cointegration data.
